integrity: The claim is proved directly from the norm definition, an explicit three-edge coloring of the binary tree, a vertexwise energy inequality, and an exact counting argument for segment indicators. Numerical decimals are only evaluations of closed-form constants and are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The lower Hilbert-comparison constant is not claimed optimal. The theorem concerns the preliminary first-attempt norm \(N_1\) on the real dyadic tree, not the final \(X_\alpha\) norm or the exact Banach--Mazur distance.
title: Three-edge decomposition sharpens the Hilbert comparison for the first dyadic-tree variation norm
